LSPU-LB ACADEMIC PROGRAMS: OVERVIEW
Laguna State Polytechnic University - Los Banos Campus (LSPU-LB) offers 23 degree programs across 8 colleges. All programs are four-year programs.

Colleges and the programs they offer:
- College of Arts and Sciences (CAS): Bachelor of Science in Psychology
- College of Business Administration and Accountancy (CBAA): Bachelor of Science in Business Administration - Major in Marketing Management; Bachelor of Science in Accountancy; Bachelor of Science in Business Administration - Major in Financial Management
- College of Computer Studies (CCS): Bachelor of Science in Computer Science - Major in Intelligent Systems; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Major in Animation and Motion Graphics; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Major in Web and Mobile Application Development; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Major in Service Management Program
- College of Criminal Justice Education (CCJE): Bachelor of Science in Criminology
- College of Fisheries (CF): Bachelor of Science in Fisheries

h:additionalInfo: 15 of the 23 programs lead to a PRC licensure examination: BS Psychology (Psychometrician), BS Accountancy (CPA), BS Criminology (Criminologist), BS Fisheries (Fisheries Professional Licensure Examination, formerly the Fisheries Technologist exam), BS Food Technology (Food Technologists Licensure Examination), BS Nutrition and Dietetics (Nutritionist-Dietitian), and all 9 CTE teacher-education programs (Licensure Examination for Teachers: Elementary for BEEd, Secondary for the rest). The 8 programs without a board exam are BS Computer Science, both BS Business Administration majors, the three BS Information Technology majors, BS Tourism Management, and BS Hospitality Management.
h:additionalInfo: All 23 LSPU-LB programs. CAS: BS Psychology. CBAA: BS Accountancy; BS Business Administration major in Marketing Management; BS Business Administration major in Financial Management. CCS: BS Computer Science major in Intelligent Systems; BS Information Technology majors in Animation and Motion Graphics, Web and Mobile Application Development, and Service Management Program. CCJE: BS Criminology. CF: BS Fisheries. CFND: BS Food Technology; BS Nutrition and Dietetics. CIHT: BS Tourism Management; BS Hospitality Management. CTE: BS Education majors in English, Filipino, Mathematics, Sciences, and Social Studies; Bachelor of Elementary Education; Bachelor of Technology and Livelihood Education major in Home Economics; Bachelor of Technical-Vocational Teacher Education major in Food and Service Management; Bachelor of Physical Education.
h:additionalInfo: Campus-wide: the Supreme Student Council (SSC), the main student government. Named organizations: Legion of Lures Esports (LURES), Psychology Society (College of Arts and Sciences), Ka-Peer Yu Organization (peer support, working with the Guidance and Counseling Unit), EsKultura (cultural and arts, with Himig EsKultura and Likha EsKultura), Ritmo EsKultura (official dance club), and Bay Breeze Group of Publications (campus publication). Each of the 8 colleges also has its own student council, including the CCS Student Council (CCS-SC), and the colleges have their own student organizations. Full membership lists were not supplied.
h:additionalInfo: For a life-threatening emergency call 911 (national hotline) and tell the nearest guard. On campus: the Guard House at the main gate (left as you enter) for any security concern; the University Health Service clinic for medical help; the Guidance Office for emotional crisis; and your College Dean for bullying or harassment. The campus main line is (049) 308-4530 (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM), but it is not an emergency line and it is not answered after office hours; for emergencies use 911 or a guard.
h:additionalInfo: LSPU-LB offers 23 degree programs across 8 colleges. All 23 are 4-year bachelor's programs. By college: College of Teacher Education (CTE) 9; College of Computer Studies (CCS) 4; College of Business Administration and Accountancy (CBAA) 3; College of Food Nutrition and Dietetics (CFND) 2; College of Hospitality Management and Tourism (CIHT) 2; College of Arts and Sciences (CAS) 1; College of Criminal Justice Education (CCJE) 1; College of Fisheries (CF) 1. Of the 23, 15 lead to a PRC licensure examination and 8 do not.
h:additionalInfo: Main events: (1) ICAC-CAF, the sports and cultural competition among colleges; the 2026 campus level was held September 15-18, 2026 and the university-wide ICAC-CAF is scheduled for October 20-23, 2026 at the LSPU Santa Cruz Campus. (2) The LSPU Founding Anniversary; the 73rd was celebrated with activities around November 26-28, 2025. (3) College weeks: each college has its own festival week during the year, such as CCS Week and CTE Week. Also, LURES took part in the 2026 February Fair esports competition.
h:additionalInfo: Office of the Registrar: enrollment, COR, TOR, transfer credentials, grades. Accounting Office: fee assessment and clearance. Cashier: payments. OSAS: student organizations, ID validation, clearances, good moral certificates, excuse slips. Guidance Office: entrance exam and counseling. Scholarship and Financial Assistance Unit: scholarships. University Health Service: medical and dental care. Business Affairs, Marketing and Production Office: Student ID, and the sale of the ID lace, uniform fabric, University shirt, NSTP shirt and PE uniform. ICT office (inside the CCS building): activation of the student portal account. Library: reference, circulation, facilities.
h:additionalInfo: The LSPU-LB campus is in Malinta, Los Baños, Laguna. Directions start at the main gate. Turn left for the Administration Building (Registrar and Cashier/Accounting on the 2nd floor), Joey Lina Gym, CHMT and COF, and CFND beside the Guard House. Walk straight in for the Clinic, Cafeteria, Business Affairs Office and Scholarship and Financial Assistance office. Turn right for the Hall, Gender and Development, CBAA, OSAS, the University President's office, CAS, Lacson Gym, CCS, CTE and the Alumni Building. CCJE is along the road to the right, and the Library is at the end of the road to the left, outside the gate. Places listed: Campus Main Gate and Entrance, Guard House, the Hall, CCS Building (College of Computer Studies), CAS Building (College of Arts and Sciences), CTE Building (College of Teacher Education), CBAA Building (College of Business Administration and Accountancy), CFND Faculty (College of Food Nutrition and Dietetics), CHMT Building (College of Hospitality Management and Tourism), COF Building (College of Fisheries), CCJE Building (College of Criminal Justice Education), Cafeteria, Lacson Gymnasium, Joey Lina Gymnasium, Office of Student Affairs and Services (OSAS) Building, Business Affairs Office (BAO), Scholarship and Financial Assistance (SFA) Office, Office of the Registrar, Campus Library, Cashier and Accounting Office, University Health Service / Clinic, Administration Building and Campus Director's Office, Office of the University President, Alumni Building, Gender and Development (GAD) Building, Parking Areas, Comfort Rooms, Transportation to the Campus (Tricycles).

h:additionalInfo: Free higher education covers tuition and other school fees for qualified bachelor's degree students.
h:additionalInfo: It does not cover students who do not qualify, students with RLE subjects, opt-out students, CTP/foreign students, and graduate students, who pay through the Accounting Office and Cashier.
h:additionalInfo: Items you buy yourself are separate from tuition: uniform fabric (about Php 600-800, plus tailoring), University shirt (Php 400), NSTP shirt (Php 350), PE T-shirt and shorts (Php 500), ID lace (Php 130), OJT expenses, transport and housing.
h:additionalInfo: Laboratory costs are not on this list: they are already included in the tuition, so a student covered by free higher education pays no separate laboratory fee.
h:additionalInfo: Students not qualified for free higher education, students with RLE subjects, opt-out students, CTP/foreign students, and graduate students go to the Accounting Office for fee assessment and pay at the Cashier.
h:audience: New students
h:definition: Students enrolled or enrolling in a bachelor's degree program at LSPU are exempt from tuition and other school fees for enrolled units under the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act of 2017 (RA 10687 / UniFAST), provided they meet institutional admission and retention qualifications.

h:additionalInfo: Free higher education covers tuition and other school fees for qualified bachelor's degree students.
h:additionalInfo: It does not cover students who do not qualify, students with RLE subjects, opt-out students, CTP/foreign students, and graduate students, who pay through the Accounting Office and Cashier.
h:additionalInfo: Items you buy yourself are separate from tuition: uniform fabric (about Php 600-800, plus tailoring), University shirt (Php 400), NSTP shirt (Php 350), PE T-shirt and shorts (Php 500), ID lace (Php 130), OJT expenses, transport and housing.
h:additionalInfo: Laboratory costs are not on this list: they are already included in the tuition, so a student covered by free higher education pays no separate laboratory fee.
h:additionalInfo: Students not qualified for free higher education, students with RLE subjects, opt-out students, CTP/foreign students, and graduate students go to the Accounting Office for fee assessment and pay at the Cashier.
